issues.description: horizontal-bar-chart recomputes Math.max(...data.map(...)) inside every row iteration
issues.detail: In horizontal-bar-chart.tsx the maxValue derivation now sits inside the map callback, so it runs O(n) per row, making the render O(n^2) in the number of bars. Hoist maxValue (and total if similarly used) above the map. The category set is small today, but the invariant 'maxValue is a loop-invariant constant' should be stated and respected, not recomputed.

issues.description: getCategoryLabel heuristic is asserted but not tested, and silently breaks prior known labels
issues.detail: The new lib/categories.ts replaces an explicit lookup table with a heuristic ('<=3 chars => uppercase', version-suffix regex, special-case map). 'trustboundaries' previously rendered as 'Trust Boundaries' via the table; under the heuristic it becomes 'Trustboundaries'. The function ships with no unit tests and the docstring claims behavior the code does not deliver. State the invariant, add table-driven tests for every known category id, and either restore the explicit map or document the regression.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER now has two keys mapping to rank 4 with no comment explaining why
issues.detail: Adding Info: 4 alongside Informational: 4 creates a silent alias. A future reader cannot tell whether the API emits both spellings, whether one is a migration artifact, or whether sort stability across the two matters. Add a one-line comment stating the invariant ('API may return either spelling; both rank equally') or normalize upstream so the order table has one entry per rank.

issues.description: CategorySelector treats empty string and 'all' identically without stating why
issues.detail: handleValueChange accepts both '' and 'all' as the clear sentinel, but the Select only ever emits 'all'. The dead branch invites confusion: a reader cannot tell whether '' is a legacy contract, a defensive guard, or unreachable. Pick one sentinel and delete the other, or comment the invariant ('Select may emit "" on reset in shadcn vX').

issues.description: displayPercentage and calculatedWidth duplicate the same fallback logic with subtly different rounding
issues.detail: calculatedWidth uses (item.value / maxValue) * 100 unrounded; displayPercentage uses Math.round((item.value / total) * 100). The two values then sit beside each other on screen (bar width vs label) with no shared helper and no comment that they are measuring different denominators. Extract a small helper that returns {widthPct, labelPct} so the invariant 'width is normalized to max, label is share of total' is explicit.

review.summary: UNDER-AUDITED. The PR ships a useful UI feature but trades an explicit category-label table for a heuristic with no tests and at least one silent regression (trustboundaries -> 'Trustboundaries'), and recomputes a loop-invariant max inside a per-row map in the bar chart. Constants and selector logic gained quiet aliases (Info==Informational, ''=='all') without comments stating the invariant. None of the math is wrong in big-O terms, but several places need either a literate comment or a hoisted constant before this is safe to study, extend, or trust. State the invariants, add a small test table for getCategoryLabel, and lift the max out of the render loop.
